name: Heavy punch
notes: Startup 10 and active 4 match C8 (10/4). Recovery is clip-derived (frames_total 35 - hit_end 14 = 21); C8 target 20. F2: the clip wins. Recommend clip-matcher cut the tail to the target (blend out) and this file be re-derived. Hitstun 26 and blockstun 22 are not in rules.md: set against the C8 recovery so on-hit advantage is about +4 and on-block about +1 once the tail is cut (until then the move is minus); the harness tunes them. Boxes in units (E1, 200/m, origin at the feet, 1.8 m = 360) read from the stills in docs/assets/clips/ryo/. Extra hurtbox = the extended limb. Rising uppercut: the box spans chest to head height.
